page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-16-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 124.0 GB of RAM, providing 7.75 GB of memory per core. Storage is bundled with 539 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity across two drives. The processor includes a 504 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and int8 operations.

In benchmark testing, the server demonstrates top-tier single-core capabilities. The Geekbench single-core score of 2256.0 and Geekbench text processing score of 2913.0 both rank in the top 10% of tested instances. Single-threaded compression and decompression tasks also show strong performance, with gzip compression reaching 36.02 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression reaching 15.11 GB/sec. Multi-core performance, such as the Geekbench multi-core score of 13417.0 and stress-ng multi-core CPU performance of 17938.08, falls within the average range. Memory bandwidth tests show an average read-only small block speed of 1351.59 GB/sec and a write large block speed of 56.58 GB/sec.

This configuration is suitable for memory-intensive workloads, database operations, and localized data processing that benefit from high-speed local NVMe storage. The inclusion of Intel AMX instructions supports specialized workloads like low-latency LLM inference, where text generation for a small 135M model achieves a top-tier speed of 366.16 tokens/sec. However, for larger models, such as the 70B parameter model, text generation data is unavailable, and prompt processing speeds drop to an average of 12.24 tokens/sec. The server does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, representing a tradeoff for applications requiring direct external access or hardware acceleration.
